Custom twisted handle kraft paper bags provide a top grip for retail purchases, gift cartons and sealed takeaway containers. The P01 reference shows a natural brown body with side gussets, separate twisted paper cords, interior attachment patches and a folded base. products.short_description:
Custom die cut handle kraft paper bags provide an integrated handhold for lightweight retail goods, accessories and event packs. The P05 reference uses an elongated rounded opening in the upper brown panel instead of separate attached handles. Side gussets create depth, while the folded bottom forms a rectangular footprint and the center panel provides a clear logo position.

For this structure, the space around the cutout matters as much as the overall bag dimensions. VPN reviews usable height, opening shape, paper and any proposed reinforcement against the packed goods and intended carrying conditions. The photos do not establish a load rating, paper GSM or a particular reinforcement layer. Approve those details through a physical sample and written specification. Plan from the general 1,000-unit custom-order minimum and confirm the final requirement in the quotation. Send the complete kit or its dimensions for a practical fit and grip review.
